name: Keep unchanged areas
description: After an edit model redraws a picture, keep the original everywhere the edit did not really change it: a soft mask of the changed areas, and the edit pasted through it onto the original, so the rest stays the original pixel for pixel. The edit must have the same framing as the original, only resized: it is stretched to the original's size, so a cropped edit would be displaced.

inputs.name: edited
inputs.label: Edited
inputs.description: The edit model's result. It may be another size or aspect ratio, but the same framing (resized, not cropped or padded); it is stretched to the original's size first.

inputs.name: blur
inputs.label: Blur
inputs.description: Blur radius in pixels applied to both pictures before they are compared, so the model's fine grain is not mistaken for a change.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.label: Threshold
inputs.description: How different a pixel must be to count as changed: the summed difference of red, green and blue, 0 to 1. Lower catches fainter changes and more noise.

inputs.name: speck
inputs.label: Speck size
inputs.description: Changed areas narrower than about twice this many pixels are dropped as noise.

inputs.name: close
inputs.label: Fill gaps
inputs.description: Unchanged gaps narrower than about twice this many pixels inside a changed area are filled.

inputs.name: margin
inputs.label: Margin
inputs.description: Pixels added around the changed areas. A larger margin (about 28) also catches dark-to-dark changes.

inputs.name: feather
inputs.label: Feather
inputs.description: How far the edge of the mask fades outward, in pixels.
